0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Ersabel looks at you expectantly, which can mean only one thing.

24.original: Use the sickly sweet nectar at the designated location and slay the snapmint for its leaves.

25.original: Deliver the snapmint leaves to Ersabel.

48.original: Pardon me, <hex:02080EE905FF056D697373FF0473697203>, but could I trouble you to help me with preparations for <hex:02083DE3E90C0DFF1B020817E3E90C05FF096D65616C74696D65FF0773757070657203FF1B020817E3E90C12FF07737570706572FF096D65616C74696D650303>?

49.original: Thank you. I have need of a rather peculiar herb, but I fear I am ill-suited to gathering it myself.

50.original: It grows on snapmint, you see. Their camouflage makes them difficult to find, and even if I should, I would likely be devoured before I could pluck even a single leaf from their hides.

51.original: Take this nectar and sprinkle it about the fields to the north. When they come out of hiding, that will be your chance to strike.

52.original: Once they catch the scent of the nectar, they will be compelled to show themselves. That will be your chance to strike.

53.original: Were you able to find any snapmint?

54.original: Goodness, these leaves are so large. Thank you.

55.original: I could never hope to cook my prahok without this.

56.original: Are you familiar with this dish? After leaving our fish to dry, it is salted then fermented. Once ready, you then mix it with a grilled meat of your choice, and wrap it in leaves of snapmint.

57.original: It keeps quite well, so we eat it often. Though the recipe is simple, you can add all manner of herbs and spices to suit your tastes.

58.original: Should you have the opportunity, I insist you try it for yourself.
